children: Shah brings over two decades of experience across pharmaceuticals, FMCG and professional services

Apothecon Pharmaceuticals has appointed Jigr Jayesh Shah as Group Chief Financial Officer, bringing more than two decades of experience across finance, governance, taxation, compliance and strategic planning. Shah will be part of the company’s executive leadership, with his remit covering key finance functions and business planning.
Shah has worked across financial planning, business finance, treasury, taxation, corporate governance, compliance, working capital, financial controls and transformation.

Before joining Apothecon Pharmaceuticals, Shah was Head of Business Finance at Alembic Pharmaceuticals, where he was responsible for the international business across the US, Europe and other markets. He previously served as Cluster Finance Head – AAA at Dr Reddy’s Laboratories, handling finance responsibilities across major international markets.
He also spent more than a decade at Mega Lifesciences, where he rose to Regional Financial Director. Earlier in his career, Shah worked with ITC, EY and Deloitte India.

Across these roles, Shah has gained experience in international finance and pharmaceutical operations, along with acquisition integration, ERP transformation, IFRS, working capital optimisation and financial strategy.
His previous roles have involved finance responsibilities across multiple geographies, including the US and Europe, adding an international dimension to his experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Shah holds a Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance from M.S. University. He is also a qualified Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant and Company Secretary.

His professional background combines accounting and financial management with governance, compliance and strategic planning. His experience across professional services, FMCG, and pharmaceuticals includes both corporate and international finance responsibilities.

At Apothecon Pharmaceuticals, Shah’s appointment comes as the company strengthens its executive finance leadership. His responsibilities are expected to include finance, governance, compliance and strategic planning.
The appointment also adds a finance executive with experience across pharmaceutical businesses and international operations to the company’s leadership structure.
Shah’s career spans more than 20 years across professional services and corporate finance, with roles covering financial management, business finance and international operations.
